notes: Seed https://www.co.mcculloch.tx.us/ loads; ELECTION INFO page lists results (some files on newtools.cira.state.tx.us). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Only county cumulative reports are posted for the three elections, each uploaded the morning or day after election night (Last-Modified differs per file). No precinct reports for any target election (the county did post a precinct report for the March 2022 primary).
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER by check 2 (county cumulative reports only), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; no upload is on election night, so confidence is low.
